title: Symmetry painting
examples: Teacher, what does it mean to be symmetrical?
Can we make a butterfly using symmetry?
How do I find the line of symmetry?

explain.say: Look at this picture. Can you see the line down the middle?
In a mirror pattern, both sides look the same.
Fold a piece of paper in half. Open it and paint on one side. Fold it, press, and open it again.

items: Open it and paint on one side

explain.say: The fold makes a crease in the paper. The crease is the line of symmetry.
A butterfly has symmetry. Its left wing matches its right wing.
Look in a mirror. Your face is almost the same on both sides.

faq.a: Symmetry means one side of your artwork is a mirror image of the other side.
asks: How do I make something look balanced?

faq.q: Do I need a mirror to find symmetry?
faq.a: No. You can fold your picture to check if both sides match.
asks: How do I check for symmetry?

faq.q: How do I use folding for art?
faq.a: Fold the paper and open it. Paint on one side. Fold and press, then open it to see the matching print.
asks: Can I draw on both sides?

faq.a: Many things in nature, like leaves and butterflies, have symmetry. Some things are not perfectly symmetrical.

faq.q: What if my drawing is not symmetrical?
faq.a: That is okay. Art does not have to be perfect. You can try again to make the sides match.
asks: What if I mess up the symmetry?
Can I still make art if it's not perfect?

facts: Symmetry means that two sides are like a mirror image.
When you fold paper, the crease line is the line of symmetry.
Butterflies and many leaves show natural symmetry.
You can create symmetrical art by folding paper in half.

quiz.say: Fold a heart in half. What is the fold called?
quiz.show: 💗 Fold it in half. What is the fold?
quiz.why: The fold splits the heart into two matching halves. It is the line of symmetry.

wrong.0: The edge is the outside of the heart.
wrong.2: A corner is where two lines meet.

quiz.say: How do the two sides of a symmetrical picture look?
quiz.why: Each side is a mirror image of the other.

wrong.1: When the sides are very different, they do not match.
wrong.2: An empty side has nothing to match the other side.

quiz.say: What is the first step to make a mirror print?
quiz.why: Folding first makes the line where the two halves meet.

wrong.0: Cutting comes later, if you need it at all.
wrong.1: You paint just one side, and the fold prints the other.
